production: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for original Android 2D cozy game Mochi Arcade. TRANSPARENT background with real alpha. Exactly 8 separate sticker-like cartoon illustrations in an equal 4-column by 2-row grid, each centered in its own square cell with generous transparent gutters and no overlap. Canvas ideally 2048 by 1024. No text, no letters, no UI, no frame, no surrounding scenery. Consistent warm cocoa thin outline, soft gouache peach/pistachio/lavender/yolk pastels, delicate paper paint grain, crisp clean alpha edges, two-dimensional hand-painted kawaii stationery style. Row1 from left: (1) cheerful round strawberry with small orange and blueberry, (2) cluster of three pastel soap bubbles with tiny smiling faces and leaf, (3) three-layer pink and pistachio cake with strawberry on top, (4) three happy cream and sky-blue bouncy marbles with tiny star. Row2 from left: (5) three cream square game tiles with simple flower/leaf/cherry symbols, (6) original round cream mochi bunny hopping above pink macaron, (7) pastel square numbered puzzle tiles displaying only clear numerals 2,4,8 with little leaf, (8) cute peach jelly orange whole and two separated juicy halves. Every subject entire silhouette visible. No extra items. These are final usable game card icons, not a mockup. All objects same soft sunlight upper left, restrained shadows directly under objects, transparent around each illustration.
